title: A novel SOX10 mutation causing Waardenburg syndrome type 2 by expressing a truncated and dysfunctional protein in a Chinese child.
authors: Li, Zhongxia; Xu, Ke; Zhou, Zhumei; Liang, Chi; Gu, Weiyue; Ran, Jianyu
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过全外显子测序鉴定SOX10突变并利用AlphaFold2预测突变蛋白结构，涉及转录因子SOX10与DNA结合域（HMG）的结构变化，但核心是临床致病突变分析，缺乏直接TF-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法深度应用。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to identify the causative variants in a patient with Waardenburg syndrome (WS) type 2 using whole exome sequencing (WES). METHODS: The clinical features of the patient were collected. WES was performed on the patient and his parents to screen causative genetic variants and Sanger sequencing was performed to validate the candidate mutation. The AlphaFold2 software was used to predict the changes in the 3D structure of the mutant protein. Western blotting and immunocytochemistry were used to determine the SOX10 mutant in vitro. RESULTS: A de novo variant of SOX10 gene, NM_006941.4: c.707_714del (p. H236Pfs*42), was identified, and it was predicted to disrupt the wild-type DIM/HMG conformation in SOX10. In-vitro analysis showed an increased level of expression of the mutant compared to the wild-type. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings helped to understand the genotype-phenotype association in WS2 cases with SOX10 mutations.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在通过全外显子测序（whole exome sequencing, WES）鉴定一名2型瓦登堡综合征（Waardenburg syndrome, WS）患者中的致病变异。方法：收集患者的临床特征。对患者及其父母进行WES以筛查致病的遗传变异，并通过Sanger测序验证候选突变。使用AlphaFold2软件预测突变蛋白三维结构的变化。采用Western blotting和免疫细胞化学法在体外测定SOX10突变体。结果：鉴定出SOX10基因的一个新生变异，NM_006941.4: c.707_714del (p. H236Pfs*42)，预测该变异会破坏SOX10中野生型DIM/HMG构象。体外分析显示，与野生型相比，突变体的表达水平升高。结论：我们的发现有助于理解携带SOX10突变的WS2病例中的基因型-表型关联。
